name: Alice
source:
An enigmatic youth you met in the pitch black world. He's always lethargic without having an interest in anything, a so-called shut-in. That being said, he's a very talkative quibbler and has malicious tongue. He often says things that would turn the entire world against him.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2014/10/17/taisho-alice-introduction/]Otome Jikan[/URL].]
